{{Top|leg}}
'''Fungus droids''' were a type of small fungus-shaped [[Surveillance droid/Legends|surveillance droid]] created by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The fungus droids were dispatched on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] worlds. Each droid was mobile enough to insinuate itself near [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bases, and carried a collection of recorders and transmitters to beam information back to Republic agents.
